Of all the tickets printed for "Triple Red 7s Multiplier", about half are still unsold. The game is near the midpoint of its run, with six of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "Triple Red 7s Multiplier" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
802.headline: How much has sold

803.body:
"Triple Red 777s" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

The table below shows the full count for "Triple Red 777s", with every prize level included.
